parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the rotation lids of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard sheet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a flap that can be opened or closed to cover the box and protect its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the top edge of the box body, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the cardboard box, made of the same material as the rest of the box.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in sealing the box when folded inward, providing closure and protection.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line at the top edge of the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is a third rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to the full closure of the box when all lids are folded inward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its fold line, moving up and down to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid of the cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It completes the top closure of the box, overlapping with other lids for secure sealing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main base body of the cardboard box, forming the container structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage space and structural support for the box, holding the contents securely.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the foundation for the rotating lids.
